Programmed MD OS 1.63 dumps for `elektronDataCorpusTest`: content generated by
`mdDataLayerFirmwareTest corpus` (random but valid patterns, kits, songs,
globals), pushed through the codec into the emulated firmware and saved as the
firmware's raw read-back replies. No factory content, no ROM data.

- `programmed_pattern_0`: 64-step capable, all 64 pooled locks used
- `programmed_pattern_1`: no locks
- `programmed_song_0`: 256 rows (the maximum, END included); `song_1`: END only
